comment: Layout rules (docs/design/04 §0; D-001, D-016). 'panels' are the two PanelSettings, both Scale With Screen Size: 'wide' (1280x720, the reference canvas) and 'narrow' (430x780, the shipped narrow board); 'screenMatch' is expand | shrink | matchWidthOrHeight (with 'match' 0 = width .. 1 = height). The layout is 'narrow' when the viewport width is at most 'narrowMaxWidth'. Height bands (viewport px, ported from the shipped CSS): standard >= standardMinHeight, compact >= compactMinHeight, below that the upright gate ('gateBelowHeight'). 'minPhysical' is enforced after scaling (physical px): touch targets, hand, combat footer, map header, pile button, value text, header text. 'categoryNav' feeds the Rule 11 rail-or-selector model (reference px): rail width, the narrowest pane a rail leaves, the tap floor per category, the vertical chrome around the list, and the hysteresis that stops flapping.
